groups.problem: record_for_host compares URI.host (no port) against stored hosts that validation allows to include a port, so port-qualified hosts never match.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same port mismatch between validation/storage and lookup in record_for_host.

groups.problem: The save callback overwrites host.category with findById(categoryId), ignoring the uncategorized category the server substitutes when categoryId is null.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same callback replacing the server-returned category with the null pre-save selection.

groups.problem: The migration inserts legacy host values verbatim without stripping scheme and path, so record_for_host no longer matches them.
groups.rationale: Same lines, same issue: raw SQL inserts skip the model's normalization.

groups.problem: The migration indexes [0]['id'] on a category query that can return no rows, so it crashes before reaching the uncategorized fallback.
groups.rationale: All describe the same unguarded empty-result access in the migration's category lookup. The note about the fallback query is part of the same fix.
